svg.title: Write your page shell once with Jinja2 inheritance — without leaving an XSS hole open
svg.desc: A Jinja2 base template (large rectangle) with a child page (smaller rectangle) inheriting via an arrow, a red bypass line from user input straight into the rendered output, and a small autoescape toggle switch in the off position. Trace Bloom generative banner for “Write your page shell once with Jinja2 inheritance — without leaving an XSS hole open”. A isometric lattice probed by 2 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1968609482.
